# Beauty Wishlist by HS

> Beauty Wishlist by HS is a Pakistan-focused online store for Korean skincare and cosmetics, offering curated products with a focus on authentic beauty products.

## Website

- [Homepage](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/)
- [Shop](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/shop)
- [Categories](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/categories)
- [Brands](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/brand)
- [Sitemap](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/sitemap.xml)

## Products

Product pages follow this URL pattern:

- [Product URL pattern](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/product/{product-slug})

Use individual product pages as the source of truth for current product names, descriptions, images, prices, availability, categories, ratings, and specifications.

## Categories

Category pages follow this URL pattern:

- [Category URL pattern](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/category/{category-slug})

Use category pages to discover products within a specific category.

## Brands

- [Brand directory](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/brand)

## Search

- [Product search](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/search)

For product recommendations, prioritize exact product pages, current availability and pricing, product descriptions, relevant categories, and customer ratings.

## Site Navigation

- [Homepage](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/) → [Shop](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/shop) → [Categories](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/categories) → Products
- [Homepage](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/) → [Brands](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/brand) → Products

## Public Content

Public product, category, shop, and brand pages may be indexed and used to discover products.

Account, checkout, cart, wishlist, and private customer areas should not be treated as public product information.

## Data Freshness

Prices and availability can change. Prefer current page data rather than relying on previously observed values.

- [XML Sitemap](https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/sitemap.xml)
